sources.text: Eric Adler Laboratory Principal Investigator Eric D. Adler, M.D. Professor of Medicine Medical Director of Heart Transplant Department of Medicine University of California San Diego Dr. Adler Bio Danon Disease The Adler lab is currently researching the natural history of Danon Disease The study's primary focus is to work closely with affected families to clearly define the characteristics of Danon Disease. Our most exciting endeavor involves inviting patients to UC San Diego's future multidisciplinary Danon clinic. Danon Disease News $3.25 Million Donation Made Toward Heart Disease Research at UC San Diego UCSD's Dr. Adler awarded $1.4M for stem cell research Young patient's skin cells used as a heart model Can you help us fight Danon Disease? We are seeking families who have been affected by Danon Disease to participate in a natural history study! Contact our team

sources.text: Contact Altman Clinical and Translational Research Institute Directions Take Interstate 5 (North or South) to the Genesee Ave exit. Use the right 2 lanes to turn right onto Genesee Ave (from I-5 north). Use the left 2 lanes to turn onto Genesee Ave (from I-5 south). Turn Right onto Campus Point Dr. Turn Right at the 2nd cross street to stay on Campus Point Dr. Turn Right on Medical Center Dr. ACTRI building will be on the right. Printable Version of Map Research Team Email: danondiseaseresearch@ucsd.edu ACTRI Office: Phone: (858) 822-0268 Fax: 858-246-2367 Outpatient Research Clinic: Front Desk: (858) 534-1251 Mailing Address: Altman Clinical and Translational Research Institute Building 9500 Gilman Drive, MC 0990 La Jolla, CA 92093-0990 Physical Address: Altman Clinical and Translational Research Institute Building 9452 Medical Center Drive La Jolla, CA 92037 ______________________________________________________________________________________________ Biomedical Research Facility II Directions Take Interstate 5 (North or South) to the La Jolla Village Drive exit. Go West on La Jolla Village Drive (From I-5 south, turn right. From I-5 north, turn left). Follow La Jolla Village Drive to Villa La Jolla Drive. Turn Right onto Villa La Jolla Drive. Follow Villa La Jolla Drive to the T-intersection where Villa La Jolla meets Gilman Drive. Parking is available at the Gilman Parking Structure at the top of the T intersection. There is also a parking lot (P602) to the left of the intersection. From Gilman Parking, cross the street and cross through the staff parking lot towards the lawns. Continue walking straight so that Stein Clinical Research Building is to the left and the Medical Teaching Facility is on the right. The Biomedical Research Facility II is the 5 story glass building straight ahead. The Division of Biomedical Informatics is located on floor 5A.
